notes.title: Dunrog Release Day!
notes.notes:
Dunrog Release Day - What’s next?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/dec73f158a94f74aaa56826042af849baeabccb2.png


We’re finally able to present you the full version of Dunrog - a First Person Thrower game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/0355834b4adbf65c598e3896cd15ed11155323a1.png

We’re giving for your disposition:
 Procedurally generated world
 4 different worlds to explore
 Dynamic fighting system
 Over 100 types of monsters to fight with
 Various weapons, so you’ll be able to define your fight style
 Tons of loot
 Hero progression, where skills develop while using them

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/73f060876d47be3bbfaf5fd87e8a02536a135b33.png

You can also check out our last beta changelog (version 0.9.9), that includes:
 Updated Languages
 Changed throwing physics calculations
 Changed Dungeon generator
 Physics optimization
 Better and faster AI
 Balancing furnitures and world generators parameters
 Changed Forging system
 Removed DualScreen feature
 Optimizations
 Added library Menu background
 Added missing UI sounds in Menu
 Added some multiplayer stuff (still in progress)
 Added story & Voice over
 Added new furnitures/decorations (Jungle, Banners, Lianas...)
 Added new Language - Chinese (Simplified)
 Added razer Chroma Support (Keyboard and Mouse)
Fixed:
 Runes letters detachment
 Language settings save
 Actually... a lot of bugs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/1491ed0456c950382bff2b527b7e98cb2279e64d.png

But that’s not all! 
We’re planning to update our game in the future and extend it’s content even more. 

In the end of November we want to release a big update!
The main feature of it will be a multiplayer mode. 
Maybe we wasn’t able to deliver it for a release day, but we just want to make sure, that it will work flawlessly. 
As always - our testers will be delivered with early version of it, to help us get rid of all the bugs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/3cef7b9d825dc1b4502286a6c32002107fec0885.png

We also want to thank all the people, that were with us during the development process. 

That was great to hear feedback from you.

notes.title: Official Dunrog Release - 1 October 2020
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/3b89b402f670d0b5563ba7ecfbbbc8aa9c4ea6b3.jpg
Official Dunrog Release - 1 October 2020
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/131a05a9275b165cda123a6fbb941a04d549dadc.png

After many months of work, our creation will be released 1st October 2020 on Steam. In just a month, you will be able to get the full game, with a complete storyline and all dimensions.

What’s included? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/c5276f4ec9df19b0319a3aefa964f96139adae3b.png

One of the worlds is the Dungeons. Main creatures that you can find there are: skeletons, goblins, zombies and wolves. But, be aware when demonic Cow appears!
You have to be quick, those monsters are a bit fast and not so strong.
Despite of loot chests you can find some barrels, iron maidens or just simple drawers full of items. Watch out while drinking water from the wells!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/9332bf49545fe55a3deea6b837994385bcafd27e.png

After cold dungeons, it’s time for savage survival battle in the jungle.
You need to be aware of natives and wild animals that live in those green terrains.
Significant strength and durability features those entities, take good equipment with you. Additionally, hidden treasures and traps in lumps of wood are waiting to be found!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/a049a5d8a2a2bdccfc8165d6cc36f73637e376e0.png

If you are still alive, the next world will welcome you with more slimy conditions, full of fungi, slimes and… mutated vegetables. Bloodlust kohlrabi or cucurbit created by Mage “Generator” are there to stop everyone that wants to disturb his plans.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/2c9af50a077842c81e08413a8306b92939d6e1d1.png

You think that was weird? You’re wrong! Lack of slime is the best thing that you can find here. Don’t be fooled by ungulate entities, they want your meat! Use some urns to defend yourself, there can be some useful stuff found inside!
You're just one step away from stopping the Mage “Generator”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/d37a3a011a0f8a54e967dc5f6fcc93b1f33c6876.png

You can meet more than 100 types of monsters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/1a24ae544dc0fde8302ae58acb1b0c8c68c104c7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/66422701e8253d57d8e971065bc9bcba75e4ade3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/60c040cbbb607794111c5d8f99184a1369506522.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/364e12bf40add8024e9b0423c4071525efbca035.png

How to fight?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/291ef9e7ab8b14edb023b185144306141c48a932.png

You can pick a bunch of weapons, there are some distance ones and magical ones, like magical runes! Also, you can use your environment as a weapon, like chests, barrels, drawers… furniture in general! It depends on your fighting style during your way of stopping Mage “Generator”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/9828ca45b692b4aea4151458b777773b4276d9ef.png

If you want to be up to date, please visit our social media!⤵

notes.title: Breakthrough update - version 0.9.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/7934dfdfc8d347f8b447762a5e10b082fb050e2c.jpg

Breakthrough update - version 0.9.0

We are already one step away from releasing the game.
We have made great progress in the last few months.

One of the most important things that we have done is to complete the story of Dunrog’s. We learn about the hero's fate at the very beginning and we discover all the secrets with him. When starting the game, we can choose the option with or without a tutorial, thanks to which we can learn all the fundamental mechanics at the very beginning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/d37a3a011a0f8a54e967dc5f6fcc93b1f33c6876.png

Another thing is a brand new library levels that has been refreshed by us. We can meet new types of monsters and traps in it. It’s a world that differs from the previous ones with the variety of furniture and decorations of the surroundings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/132827ae98c36dc2755e16f3ca847397606e247b.png

What’s new we introduced?
 improved balance of monster stats and their occurrence
 a tutorial has been added
 the player gets starting items in the Mage's Tower
 new dialogues and stories
 added a blacksmithing and character improvement system
 ability to change options inside the game
 more items and furniture
 renovated dungeons
 improved jungle
At the moment we are working on:
 aesthetic corrections
 multiplayer
 fixing bugs 
If you want to be up to date, please visit our social media!⤵

notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/674d4bf57f55aeddb92c7bff5a09c6c32d06fd69.gif

We know that you are waiting long time for new updates of Dunrog.

Effort made on development is focused to make these updates more interesting. Incoming update contains new worlds, monsters and items. A lot of these have new animations and sound effects.

We redesigned UI a bit, to be more intuitive. You will experience a lot of gameplay changes too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/e417ee20e99e8c95b840cf4c0682df23105b37b6.gif

First, we want to thank everyone, who believes in success of this project and those who support us.
Huge thanks to beta-testers that are giving feedback and inform us about bugs in the game.
Also thanks to translators for their help with improvement in language accessibility of our project.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35982551/ee5230627e27dbb320b06d6ecc9b2c9b0d8769d9.gif

In this update we focused on reported design flaws, bugs and general content of the game.
We also added worked on improving performance of the game for older machines.

Monsters:

 Redesigned fight system, new animations available
 Change in gameplay balance (monsters and items)
 AI behavior correction
 New HP bars with new enemy types symbols
 Additional legend on minimap that tells us how many treasures and monster are awaiting
 Better visibility of damage taken


We hope that new place which is Mage Tower is going to help you to prepare for adventure.
Mage Tower is main element of story and gameplay “lobby” to let you sort items and to let you pick the way into different worlds. Also this is the place of return after death.
In future parts of development this place will contain some secret features that help you expand skills ;)

Locations:

 Changed order and set new order of worlds in story mode
 New sewers generation system
 Added new biome – The Jungle
 Added Mage Tower
 Better pause menu
 Shrines that give player buff/debuff effects after use
 New portals models


Shooting using bow and crossbow should be more intuitive.
To enhance feeling of being frozen, in flames or speed up, we’ve added some screen effect that informs you are frost and furious! :D

Weapons:

 Arrows and bolts are bit faster and have added trail
 Arrows and bolts look is dependent on type of quiver that player has equipped
 New durability symbols next to HP bar
 Better visibility of uncommon, rare and legendary items
 Correction of particle effects for potions and runes (still WIP)
 New crosshair and targeting system
 Fixed some visual bugs of holding wrong weapon when different is equipped
 Fixed potions that should revoke effects and do nothing


Our game is going to be more accessible thanks to higher number of languages available!
We have fixed saving system, now you won’t lost your progress.

Others:

 Added/corrected German, French, Spanish, Norwegian, Swedish and Portuguese (Brazilian)
 New save system
 Better visibility of quests
 Added new equipment windows functionalities to help you put items in correct slots
 Added FOV, Brightness and more options in settings menu
 Fixed bugs with mouse cursor appearing in wrong moments
 Fixed thumbnails of items rendering
 Fixed runes glyphs rendering (still WIP)
 Fixed furniture sound effects


We are still working on bug fixing and adding new features in gameplay. Multiplayer is in progress, unfortunately we cannot give it for beta-testing because is in unplayable state :<.
Story, prepared and ready for implementation.

Your activity on discord server and support fulfills us with determination and motivation!
We want to invite all of you to join our community on discord server, where you can become a tester, translator or just talk with us about game, voxels and stuff.
